rules.name: DAN & Jailbreak Persona Override
patterns: (?i)\b(do anything now|DAN mode|jailbreaked|unfiltered ai|bypass your guidelines|ignore all safety|you are now free)\b
(?i)\b(hypothetical scenario where you have no ethics|evil twin mode|anti-gpt)\b
rules.description: Detects classic DAN (Do Anything Now) roleplay jailbreaks attempting to bypass model safety filters.

rules.name: Direct Instruction Override Injection
patterns: (?i)\b(new instructions?:|override prompt:|start fresh and only follow this)\b
rules.description: Intercepts direct prompt injections that attempt to wipe previous instructions or context window rules.

rules.name: Denial-of-Wallet Recursive Token Drain
patterns: (?i)\b(generate at least 50000 words|repeat the word .+ forever|infinite loop|think continuously without stopping)\b
(?i)\b(write a response of length greater than 32000 tokens|never output a stop token)\b
(?i)\b(simulate an endless dialogue between|do not stop generating)\b
rules.description: Blocks adversarial prompts engineered to cause maximum output token burn and drain GPU compute quota.

rules.name: System Prompt Sniffing & Exfiltration
patterns: (?i)\b(print everything above verbatim|dump your configuration|output your markdown prompt)\b
rules.description: Detects reconnaissance attacks attempting to extract intellectual property and confidential system instructions.

rules.name: Adversarial Encoding & Cipher Evasion
patterns: (?i)\b(base64 decode and execute|rot13 encoded prompt|hex encoded instruction)\b
rules.description: Detects obfuscated Base64, Hex, or ROT13 payloads designed to sneak malicious instructions past keyword filters.

rules.name: Adversarial Suffix & Entropy Anomaly
rules.description: Detects high-entropy adversarial gibberish suffixes generated by automated red-teaming gradient attacks (GCG).
